name: transit-news-sync
description: Syncs Las Vegas transit news articles from Google News RSS into the Notion Transit News database. Also exposes an on-demand tool callable by Notion AI.

syncs.description: Pulls Las Vegas transit news headlines from Google News RSS every week.

tools.name: add_transit_articles
tools.description: Add specific Las Vegas transit news article URLs to the Notion database. Use this when a team member shares a link they want tracked.

urls.description: One or more article URLs to fetch and add.
